rationale: Despite an ostensibly positive earnings headline, RELY gapped down 16.5% on 6.1x relative volume and has sold off steadily to sit at 1.3% of its intraday range, well below both VWAP ($21.72) and the 5m 9-EMA ($21.33). With the broader market experiencing severe liquidation (SPY -4.20%, VIXY +26.83%) and recent 1-minute candles compressing right against the session low of $20.87, the path of least resistance is a breakdown into new lows.
